pr_title: Fix Project Settings array/dicts initial value being shared instances of the current value.
pr_body:
Fixes #55856

There could be other ways to fix the issue, but this works. The issue originates here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/3c9bf4bc210a8e6a208f30ca59de4d4d7e18c04d/core/config/project_settings.cpp#L1035-L1042

`->set(...)` is done with same same value passed into `->set_initial_value(...)`, so for arrays and dicts that will be the same instance. Thus when you change the project setting value, it changes the initial too, so you can't revert or detect changes when saving.

The change in `ProjectSettings::_property_get_revert(...)` is required for the same reason, if you just return `initial` there, you will be changing the initial array/dict.

Tested with `editor/script/search_in_file_extensions` and various built-in input map inputs.

Previously you could not revert to default for the built in shortcuts/actions. This pr allows you to do that. Did you want me to split it into two PRs perhaps? They are stored in arrays hence the relevance but I Can see how it might be out of the scope for solving the issue specifically.

issue_context.title: ProjectSettings' initial array/dict values can be modified.
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

master

### System information

Win10

### Issue description

I found ProjectSettings' initial values can be modified if they are arrays. You can get the initial array reference by `ProjectSettings.get()` and modify it. 

It causes that when you modify it in Project Settings dialog, the initial value also changes. So it cannot revert and won't be saved in `project.godot`. This related to #55721.

### Steps to reproduce

### Case 1:

Open `Project Settings` dialog, find `editor/script/search_in_file_extensions` property (it is `PackedStringArray`), change it and the revert button won't show.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12966814/145706655-62c849c7-98ee-4d52-8f76-7c82c18eb778.png)

Create a plugin to test its initial value:
```GDScript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

func _enter_tree():
    print(ProjectSettings.property_get_revert("editor/script/search_in_file_extensions"))
    # will prints [gd, gdshader, 123, 456]
```

### Case 2:
Modify the property directly in plugin:
```GDScript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

func _enter_tree():
    var array = ProjectSettings.get("editor/script/search_in_file_extensions")
    array.append("123")
    var init = ProjectSettings.property_get_revert("editor/script/search_in_file_extensions")
    print(array, init) # will prints the same array
```

### Case 3:

Reproduce #55721. Modify any default input action:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12966814/145707299-aa1fc715-2c0f-46fb-b1e6-dcec285687e2.png)

Print its initial value:
```GDScript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

func _enter_tree():
    for event in ProjectSettings.property_get_revert("input/ui_accept").events:
        print(event)
#    will prints:
#    InputEventKey: keycode=16777221 (Enter), ...
#    InputEventKey: keycode=16777222 (Kp Enter), ...
#    InputEventKey: keycode=32 (Space), ...
# -> InputEventKey: keycode=71 (G), ...
```
That's why it can't affect the runtime....

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments:
More details:

1.Modifying `Array` (not Packed\*Array) and `Dictionary` in Project Settings dialog will be fine, because the EditorPropertyArray/Dict duplicates it. It does that for undo/redo but hides this issue. Maybe duplicating all Packed*Array types can fix the issue simply.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/092a2861277e7df87aec10516d713d0bf4adba79/editor/editor_properties_array_dict.cpp#L160-L172

2.The issue is only for 4.0 because in 3.x `ProjectSettings.get()` always return a duplicated array. I'm not sure if it is expected.
just to be sure: this issue is the reason why changing `editor/script/search_in_file_extensions` in project settings won't persist when restarting the editor, yes? no additional issue required?

> just to be sure: this issue is the reason why changing `editor/script/search_in_file_extensions` in project settings won't persist when restarting the editor, yes? no additional issue required?

Yes, the issue caused this.

If anyone is looking for search extensions workaround, you can set them if you manually edit the `project.godot` file. Just add this line
`script/search_in_file_extensions=PackedStringArray("gd", "shader", "tscn")`
below `[editor]`.

review_comments: Why remove that ? More precise messages are welcome no ?

Because I don't think it is an accurate reflection of what happneded 100% of the time now. Say you have 5 events which are all different to the defaults, of which there are 2. Then you reset to default. What happened technically is you just removed 3 events and changed 2 events. But with this message it would just say 'Remove Input Action Event' - which is not accurate as more than one was removed and 2 others were changed.

Eaiser to just make it a generic message imo
